The Double Arrow Bed is a bold upholstered bed frame with a unique double arrow chevron headboard, a genuine statement piece. The tall 54-inch headboard is deeply padded, and the bed is handmade to order in our Dewsbury workshop.

Key features

  • Unique double arrow chevron headboard design
  • Tall 54 inch deeply padded headboard
  • Wooden slatted base
  • Handmade to order in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire
  • Free fabric swatches available

Sizes and prices

Single (3FT) £324.99; Small Double (4FT) £376.99; Double (4FT6) £389.99; King (5FT) £415.99; Super King (6FT) £493.99. Not sure which size you need? See our bed sizes guide.

Materials & build

Built on a wooden frame and upholstered by hand in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. Fabrics: Plush Velvet, Chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy and Teddy Bouclé, in solid colours, stripes or two-tone finishes, and custom requests are welcome. Free fabric swatches let you check colours at home.

Mattress

Takes a standard UK mattress in the size you choose. Browse our mattresses, such as the 3000 Pocket Sprung Mattress, to complete the bed.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Free delivery applies across Great Britain, by our own team, typically within 3-5 working days. Northern Ireland is £90. Changed your mind? You can return it free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and we collect it. If anything arrives faulty we will replace it or refund you in full. Every bed has a 5-year frame warranty. Pay in instalments with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Frequently asked questions

How tall is the Double Arrow headboard?

The headboard is a tall 54 inches, deeply padded.

Where is the Double Arrow Bed made?

It is handmade to order in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire.

When will it arrive?

Delivery is free across Great Britain and usually takes 3-5 working days; Northern Ireland is £90.

Can I return it if it is not right?

Yes. Returns are free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and faulty items are replaced or refunded in full.

p1.descriptionHtml:
The Duchess Ottoman Bed pairs crushed velvet with a tall winged headboard, deep-buttoned by hand and finished with crystal-effect buttons, on a gas lift ottoman base with storage under the whole mattress.

Key features

  • Tall winged headboard with deep buttoning
  • Crystal-effect diamante buttons (fabric-covered buttons also available)
  • Gas-lift ottoman base with storage under the whole mattress
  • Fully upholstered to the floor, no exposed legs

Sizes and prices

Single (3FT) £324.99; Small Double (4FT) £357.99; Double (4FT6) £370.99; King (5FT) £402.99; Super King (6FT) £467.99. Need a different size or headboard height? Ask us about a bespoke version. Not sure which size to pick? See our bed sizes guide.

Materials & build

Built on a wooden frame and fully upholstered by hand in our West Yorkshire workshop, with no exposed legs. Crushed velvet with crystal-effect buttons, or fabric-covered buttons if you prefer. Free fabric swatches are available so you can see the colour in your own light before you order.

Mattress

Takes a standard UK mattress in the size you choose. Browse our mattresses, such as the Memory Orthopaedic Mattress or the 3000 Pocket Sprung Mattress, to complete the bed.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Delivery is free across Great Britain (England, Scotland and Wales) by our own team, usually within 3-5 working days. Northern Ireland is £90. You can return it free within 14 days if unused and unassembled in its original packaging (we collect it), and if an item arrives faulty we will replace it or refund you in full. Every bed has a 5-year warranty. Spread the cost with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Frequently asked questions

How does the storage work?

The base lifts on gas lifts, giving access to storage under the whole mattress. Leave clear height above the bed.

Are the buttons real crystal?

They are crystal-effect diamante buttons; fabric-covered buttons are also available.

What sizes does the Duchess Ottoman Bed come in?

Single (3FT), Small Double (4FT), Double (4FT6), King (5FT) and Super King (6FT).

Can I see the fabric first?

Yes. Free fabric swatches are available.

How long does delivery take?

Free across Great Britain, usually 3-5 working days. Northern Ireland is £90.

How do I care for it?

Vacuum gently with a soft brush attachment and blot spills straight away with a clean, damp cloth.

p3.descriptionHtml:
The Eagle Kensington Chesterfield Bed is a Chesterfield bed with deep diamond button tufting across a tall 54-inch floor-standing headboard, matched by an equally well-finished footboard. It is handmade to order in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire, from £384.99 in Single 3ft to £519.99 in Super King 6ft, with free delivery across Great Britain.

Key features

  • Classic Chesterfield deep diamond button tufting
  • Matching upholstered headboard and footboard
  • 54" tall floor-standing headboard
  • Plush Velvet, Naples or Chenille in a wide fabric colour selection
  • Optional ottoman gas-lift storage
  • Comes with a wooden slatted base

Sizes

Available in the sizes below, with prices from the current listing. Not sure which size to choose? See our UK bed sizes guide or email us.

  • Single 3ft: £384.99
  • Small Double 4ft: £439.99
  • Double 4ft6: £454.99
  • King 5ft: £489.99
  • Super King 6ft: £519.99

Materials & build

Solid support base, handmade to order in our workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. Upholstery is Plush Velvet, Naples or Chenille, in solid colours, stripes or two-tone; custom fabric and colour options are available on request.

Storage

Optional ottoman gas-lift storage is available. Call us on 07417 439197 to talk through the option and any price difference.

Mattress compatibility

Order the size that matches your mattress, or add our Memory Orthopaedic Mattress from £142.99. With a footboard, allow for it when you measure the room.

Customisation

Choose your fabric and colour, with free swatches so you can see them in person first.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Every Eagle Bed is made to order in our Pepproyd Street workshop in Dewsbury. Delivery is free across Great Britain (England, Scotland and Wales) by our own team, usually within 3–5 working days. Delivery to Northern Ireland is £90.

Changed your mind? You have 14 days for free returns (we collect it free) as long as the item is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging. If anything arrives faulty we will arrange a free replacement or a full refund. Every bed also carries a 5-year warranty, and you can spread the cost with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout.

Compare with the Royal Chesterfield Wingback Bed or the Chesterfield Tufted Bed, browse Chesterfield beds, and read the Chesterfield bed buying guide.

FAQ

What is a Chesterfield bed?

A Chesterfield bed has deep button tufting across the headboard. The Kensington uses classic diamond button tufting on a tall 54 inch headboard.

Does it have a footboard?

Yes, it comes with a matching upholstered footboard.

Can I add ottoman storage?

Yes. Optional ottoman gas-lift storage is available.

Can I see the fabric before I buy?

Yes. Free fabric swatches are available, so you can check colour and feel at home. Choose solid colours, stripes or two-tone, or ask about a custom fabric and colour.

What is your returns policy?

You have 14 days for free returns, with free collection, if the item is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging. Faulty items get a free replacement or a full refund.

Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon–Fri 9am–6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.
